title: Turn into tasks
intro: Open a task to edit it. Approve the tasks to create and reject the rest.
failed: The AI did not answer. Try again.
noTasks: The AI found no tasks in this message.
unavailable: Turning messages into tasks is not available right now.
createFailed: The tasks were not created. Try again.
messageGone: The message was deleted, so no tasks were created.
ticketGone: The ticket is no longer there, so no tasks were created.
filesChanged: A file on one of the tasks is no longer available. Remove it and try again.
meetingGone: The meeting is no longer there, so no tasks were created.
